reference: Published tui API contracts for metadata, pure color-mode state, and parser/uninitialized errors. Screen rendering and input need an independent ECMA-48 decoder and disposable PTY; there is no matching GNU CLI.
coverage: Bash reports tui as an available builtin.
Bash help exposes the documented tui synopsis, API families, and numeric limits.
The documented colormode choices reject an unsupported value with status 2 without opening a terminal.
Deferred: terminal initialization, drawing and refresh, rendition and ANSI handling, key input, line input, resize, and teardown.
In-memory color-mode persistence, uninitialized error and idempotent teardown without entering terminal mode.
exclusions: No GNU CLI provides an independent oracle for the persistent screen API.
The fixture runner has no private controlling PTY, terminal input driver, resize injection, or ECMA-48 screen decoder; stateful terminal operations therefore remain deferred.
No privileged, host, network, device, or system-wide operation is exercised.

cases.purpose: Verify Bash's documented type -t builtin metadata identifies the loaded tui command as a builtin.

Check Bash help text against the published tui synopsis, draw API, coordinate/timeout limits, and getkey result contract. The confirmation line is printed only after those independent documented strings are found.
cases.script:
full=$(help tui)
flat=${full//$'\n'/ }
[[ $flat == *'tui SUBCOMMAND [args...]'* ]]
[[ $flat == *'init | end | lines | cols | resized | colormode'* ]]
[[ $flat == *'hline [CH] N | vline [CH] N | box'* ]]
[[ $flat == *'Coordinates: -32768..32767; line length: 0..32767; timeout: -1..INT_MAX.'* ]]
[[ $flat == *'getkey prints a token'* && $flat == *'rc 0 key, 1 EOF, 2 timeout.'* ]]
printf 'documented tui help contract\n'

cases.purpose: The documented colormode accepts only 16, 256, or truecolor and invalid arguments return status 2; verify rejection without requiring screen initialization or a terminal.
cases.script:
if tui colormode 8; then
  status=0
else
  status=$?
fi
[[ $status == 2 ]]
printf 'unsupported colormode rejected with status 2\n'

cases.purpose: Validate init/end, fixed screen rows and columns, raw-mode entry, alternate-screen/cursor handling, and restoration after teardown.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM fixture with a private controlling PTY that supplies a fixed window size and records termios plus terminal output; compare the observed ECMA-48 stream and restored terminal state with an independent decoder. The current runner starts the shell without a controlling terminal.

cases.purpose: Validate persistent cursor movement, addstr clipping and wrapping, erase, box, horizontal/vertical lines, clear-to-end operations, and changed-cell refresh output.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM fixture with a private PTY and fixed geometry, plus an independent ECMA-48 screen decoder that checks resulting cells and exact refresh traffic. No matching GNU tui command exists and the current runner cannot provide that terminal oracle.

cases.purpose: Validate bold/dim/italic/underline/blink/reverse attributes, named/indexed/RGB colors, color-mode conversion, and addansi SGR/control parsing.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM with a private controlling PTY and an independent ECMA-48 parser that records cell attributes and colors across 16-color, 256-color, and truecolor modes. Screen output cannot be meaningfully checked by this noninteractive runner.

cases.purpose: Validate getkey character and escape-sequence tokens, queued ESC pushback, nonblocking/finite timeout status, and EOF behavior.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM fixture with a private controlling PTY and a bounded terminal-input driver that can inject key byte sequences and close only the owned input endpoint; verify tokens and statuses from the documented API.

cases.purpose: Validate getstr prompt placement, character entry, backspace editing, line completion, and ESC cancellation.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM fixture with a private controlling PTY and an input driver for deterministic key sequences, plus an independent assertion of the returned text, cancellation status, and terminal restoration.

cases.purpose: Validate resize notification and geometry updates, retained screen contents after growth/shrink, repeated init/end, and exit cleanup.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM fixture with an owned PTY, controlled window-size changes, signals delivered only to the fixture process, and an independent terminal-state/ECMA-48 observer. Those terminal controls are unavailable in the current runner.

cases.purpose: Published color-mode values persist across calls without screen initialization or terminal access.
cases.script:
tui colormode 16
tui colormode
tui colormode 256
tui colormode
tui colormode truecolor
tui colormode

cases.purpose: Known drawing commands require initialization, unknown commands use usage status, and end is idempotent.
cases.script:
if tui erase; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'erase=%s\n' "$rc"
[[ $rc == 1 ]]
if tui unknown; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'unknown=%s\n' "$rc"
[[ $rc == 2 ]]
tui end
tui end
